## lib-wazuh-active-response (C9 v0, 2026-10-22)
**Trigger:** called through Execute Workflow (waited for) by pb-ssh-bruteforce (`action: propose`: is a response possible? nothing is sent) and pb-ssh-response (`action: execute`, after an analyst's approval).
**Inputs:** `{action: propose | execute, command: 'firewall-drop', srcip, agent: {name} | {id}, config: <lib-config>, context}`.
**Actions taken:** re-checks every guardrail of lib-config `response` on each call: the kill switch (`enabled`), `mode` (dry_run / live), the command in the catalog (`commands`), a valid source address (IPv4 / IPv6), `protected_cidrs` (and in live mode at least one entry beyond loopback), the agent listed by n8n-response (so in `agent_group`, `asox-response`) and active, the address not any agent's (`protect_agent_ips`, every agent n8n-api lists), and for a live send the rate cap (`rate_cap_per_hour`, live sends in the last hour, all alerts: this workflow's static data). Logins and agent lists: credentials Wazuh API (n8n-response) and Wazuh API (n8n-api), lib-config `wazuh_http` timeout and retries (connection error, timeout, 5xx). propose: returns the request it would send. execute in dry_run: builds the request and returns it without sending. execute in live: `PUT /active-response?agents_list=<agent id>` (always that one agent) with `{"command": <api_command, e.g. firewall-drop300>, "arguments": [], "alert": {"data": {"srcip": <ip>}}}` as n8n-response, retried only when the request never reached the API; success = the agent in `data.affected_items` (Wazuh error 1652 inside a 200 = the manager has no <active-response> block: `not_sent`, or with `response.allow_no_timeout` sent again as `!firewall-drop`, which never reverts).
**Systems changed:** in live mode only, the target agent (Wazuh active response: firewall-drop of one address, reverted by the manager's <active-response> timeout); nothing in dry_run or propose.
**Approval:** required: the action blocks an IP on an agent; executed only for pb-ssh-response after an analyst's approval (tag approve:firewall-drop, interim for D-N5). propose never acts.
**Owner:** n8n.
Result: `{ok, status: proposed | dry_run | sent | not_sent | unknown | refused, code, reason, line, mode, agent, request, api, answered_at, revert}`. Never parks: failures go back to the caller. Saved: failed executions only (lib- convention); no error workflow.
